verdict.rationale: No evidence of any official CLI tool; Fidelity Private Shares is a web-based cap table/equity management platform, and probes for API/docs artifacts (llms.txt, openapi) all returned 404s, indicating no developer/CLI tooling is exposed. This is a fair axis to ask of an equity platform but nothing indicates it's delivered. Missing for 10: any mention of a CLI, SDK, or API for automation/agentic access.
